what: the public SVG surface — the version x variant dispatch and its seam checks
note: `test: null` — the whole suite. The point of this ticket's mutations is that
the *dispatch* is the only new mechanism: every builder underneath it was
already proved by its own parity file, so a mutation here has to be killed by
the new sweep and not by a sibling. Narrowing the run would hide which.
Group A is the dispatch itself — what upstream's avatar.js decides. Group B
is the public seam's own promises: the arguments that have no default, the
type check the scene model can only assert, and what the barrel exports.
The six `size is hardcoded` cases are the run that found a real hole rather
than confirming a guard. The main 600-render matrix renders at 80, so `size:
80` reproduces it exactly on every arm — and `sizePassthrough` held `marble`
alone from #33 to #59, so five of the six survived the entire suite. The
fixture now carries every variant at both sizes and all six die. Keep all six:
one per arm is the only shape that can catch the next one.
`the default variant is beam` caught the run's first survivor, and the fix was
a deletion rather than a test: `buildAvatarScene` carried its own
